number: 第二百四十八条の四の十八
heading_en: Sensitivities, etc. in Foreign Exchange Risk Buckets
summary_ja: 外国為替のバケットは報告通貨を除く通貨ごとに定め、バケット間相関は0.6とする。
summary_en: Foreign exchange buckets are set per currency other than the reporting currency, with a 0.6 correlation between buckets.
paragraphs: The buckets for delta risk and vega risk relating to foreign exchange shall be determined for each individual currency excluding the reporting currency of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company.
The correlation coefficient γ_{bc} between buckets of delta risk and between buckets of vega risk relating to foreign exchange provided in the preceding paragraph shall be 0.6 for all currencies.

sections_en.第三節 第二款 第三目: Buckets, Risk Factors, Sensitivities, Risk Weights and Correlations for Foreign Exchange
